evaluation.endpoint: A known currently unburned cell first becomes cumulatively burned during (t,t+1 hour], in the reconstruction-derived outcome process.
evaluation.interpretation: Retrospective reporting analysis; binary outcomes evaluate inferred probabilities directly, without a decision threshold.

cohorts.native: Native K-contact cells from one frozen base sampling design; complete known context; current center unburned; split unit: cell_hour
cohorts.common: Identical original 9x9 cache rows with contact inside centered 3x3; original labels and inverse inclusion weights
cohorts.generalization_scope: Within-fire cell-hour interpolation; overlapping spatial contexts and fire histories across train/validation

metric_formulas.input: y_j in {0,1}; unchanged saved p_j in [0,1]; original inverse inclusion w_j>0; row identities event,time,cell frozen.
metric_formulas.balanced: D_bal=(D_0+D_1)/2 if W_0>0 and W_1>0; undefined otherwise. Available label components retained.
metric_formulas.realized_label_probability: s_j=y_j*p_j+(1-y_j)*(1-p_j); P_j=Bern(y_j) is a degenerate empirical reference, not Bern(eta(x_j)).
metric_formulas.jensen_shannon_distance: sqrt(per-row Jensen-Shannon divergence), then weighted average.
metric_formulas.wasserstein2: sqrt(1-s_j), then weighted average; unit binary ground metric.
metric_formulas.proper_score_scope: Brier and exact logarithmic/KL loss, and positive scaling of logarithmic loss by 1/2, are strictly proper for the distribution under which expected hard-label loss is measured. Balanced Brier targets the altered 50:50-label law, not original conditional population probabilities.
metric_formulas.balanced_optimum: eta_bal(x)=eta(x)*(1-pi)/(eta(x)*(1-pi)+(1-eta(x))*pi), for original pi in (0,1). Appendix derives Bayes and risk-minimization forms.
metric_formulas.operation_order: Every nonlinear per-row transform is evaluated before within-label original-weight normalization; means of square roots are never replaced by square roots of means.
metric_formulas.numerics: float64 scoring of stored probabilities. Stable equivalent formulas may clip roundoff in squared distance/divergence to its valid range; predictions themselves are never clipped or floored.
metric_formulas.missing_support: Absent-label components and balanced aggregates encoded null in JSON/blank CSV. Positive infinite losses encoded infinity in JSON/inf CSV. Invalid nonfinite/out-of-range p, nonbinary y, nonpositive/nonfinite w or unequal shapes rejected.

analytic_claims: Ordinary kriging constrained system, unbiasedness and plus-one multiplier sign in prediction variance.
SAV and particle-diameter residence conversion from imperial to SI units, with stated empirical scope.
Uniform initiation conditional on next-hour event is an additional assumption; frozen exponential event time gives a different conditional law.
Mean new-event occupancy q*(r-r^2/2), endpoint q*r, r=min(T/D,1).
Old-event endpoint activity uses strict R>D under half-open active intervals.
Finite-cell isotropic transfer has dimensionless solid-angle/(4*pi), bounded by 1/2; conditional source intensity W/m^2 gives receiver flux W/m^2.
Incident energy equals interval seconds times interval-mean flux, J/m^2.
Unresolved nonnegative source bounds preserve known contributions and NaN complete expectations.
